text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky has made her mark in the
Twinkle
Series with numerous
spectacular results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's been the center of attention since
before
her debut, but now she's even
more renowned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, she's achieved more than just
running some
amazing races...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VROOOOOM! Screeeech!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Thanks for waiting!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Thanks for waiting!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm going to take you to a fly
spot that
only the hippest homeslices
know about!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my, aren't we suspicious! You know I'm always on the lookout for the latest trends! If I say it's fly, then you can be sure it's legit!

choice_data_list_en: Is this really a trendy spot?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So hurry up and get in! We're going to
have a
bangin' time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We're here!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Are you surprised?
choice_data_list: レース場がイケイケスポット？
choice_data_list_en: The racecourse is a happening spot?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You can always enjoy out-of-sight races
here,
whether you're cheering in the
crowd or running
on the track!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Maruzensky!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It really is! I'm always rooting for you,

Maruzensky! Good luck in the next race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh! Teehee, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You can even meet famous
Umamusume... like
me! Heehee,
kidding! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? Everyone here looks like
they're
having a great time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now let's go watch some exciting races!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
200 meters to go! She's taking the
inside... She's
broken into the lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The favorite is out ahead! She's in first
place!
Aaaand, SHE WINS!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Congrats on getting first place!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Thanks, everybody!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
You're my forever favorite! Give it your
all!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That was all that! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate
text_block_list.text: Oh! Maruzensky!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I'll be able to race against you soon, so
get ready!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll be waiting for you! See you on
the
track!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, there really is so much fun to
be had at
the racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
At first, I wasn't sure about running just
for the
fun of it...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was reluctant to make my
debut. I
even thought it might be better
not to run at all...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But now, I'm really glad I kept going!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by these adorable students,
and even
rivals, I'm having the time of
my life!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to your support, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to your support, Trainer!

I'll have to live up to your expectations
and give
you some fantastic races!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You'll be watching me, right? From your
special
place in my passenger seat!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I will! And I'll keep it going at full
throttle!
